Complete BurnerUpdated history (latest assignment block 60668990) identifies the four current Celo burners and Broker’s false state: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xccf663b1ff11028f0b19058d0f7b674004a40746/logs?topic=0xf0e5abe4ab32ea692e3889b4c146fd4ddae5f17bb40ab4feba97fb67a2d4de0f. Current minters from complete MinterUpdated history are ActivePool 0xa7873F4Bf2A1ea2EB20B1e8A992C4748e78473b2 and BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A; Broker is false: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xccf663b1ff11028f0b19058d0f7b674004a40746/logs?topic=0xb21afb9ce9be0a676f8f317ff0ca072fb89a4f8ce2d1b6fe80f8755c14f1cb19. Blockscout identifies 0xa7873F4Bf2A1ea2EB20B1e8A992C4748e78473b2 as ActivePool: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xa7873F4Bf2A1ea2EB20B1e8A992C4748e78473b2. Verified protocol paths: BorrowerOperations burns msg.sender (L728, L1091), TroveManager burns msg.sender (L919), CollateralRegistry burns msg.sender (L133, L217), StabilityPool deposits msg.sender (L277), burns address(this) (L490), and returns from address(this) (L616): https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/BorrowerOperations.sol#L728-L1091; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/TroveManager.sol#L919; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/CollateralRegistry.sol#L133-L217; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/StabilityPool.sol#L277-L616. On material Monad, StableTokenSpoke’s only burn is burn(uint256) of msg.sender (L100-L114), and NttManager pulls caller tokens before burning its own balance (L409, L429): https://github.com/mento-protocol/mento-core/blob/main/contracts/tokens/StableTokenSpoke.sol#L100-L114; https://github.com/mento-protocol/mento-stabletoken-ntt/blob/main/evm/src/NttManager/NttManager.sol#L404-L429. The same owner Safe can grant a new burner/operator; that grantability and the owner-controlled token proxy establish Possible.

oracleRisk.summary: New whole-profile review 2026-10-22 corrects the previous single-source-or-laggy finding (root review 2026-07-21, topology described at block 78952776). A singleton SortedOracles reporter is not a singleton price signer: GBPm's reporter is immutable permissionless ChainlinkRelayerV1 0x215d3ba962597defb38da439ed4db8e8a63e409a. At Celo block 78952744 (2026-10-01T11:18:22Z), its configured proxy 0xe76fe54dfed2ce8b4d1ac63c982dff7cfc92bf82 resolves to AccessControlledOffchainAggregator 0x618645d07d9ba975d976de787976f84f6c4114a7 with ten transmitters. Both relayer and DON runtime bytes exactly match verified source. This is the same external DON relay mechanism graded standard-external for BRLm and JPYm, without claiming an independent-provider fallback. Existing branch, feed and liquidation observations retain their original dates; this new review admits 2026-10-23.

branchApplicability.rationale: GBPm's material issuance path is the Celo USDm-collateralized CDP (Liquity v2 fork); its oracle and liquidation parameters were confirmed on-chain via the SystemParamsProxyGBPm contract. Monad's GBPm deployment is a separate issuer-native mirrored mint (already reviewed under mintAuthority/bridgeRouteRisk) with no independent collateral-liquidation branch of its own, so only the Celo CDP branch is inventoried here.

branches.label: GBPm/USDm CDP (Liquity v2 fork, Celo)
branches.summary: Re-reviewed 2026-10-22: FXPriceFeed -> OracleAdapter -> SortedOracles GBP/USD consumes an external Chainlink DON through immutable permissionless ChainlinkRelayerV1, not a single price signer. At block 78952744, getOracles returned only this relayer, getAggregators bound proxy 0xe76fe54dfed2ce8b4d1ac63c982dff7cfc92bf82, and its active AccessControlledOffchainAggregator had ten transmitters. Exact deployed relayer and DON runtimes match verified source. Standard-external is consistent with BRLm/JPYm; no independent-provider failover is claimed. Cached lastValidPrice serves emergency shutdown only, and earlier branch/liquidation observations are not renewed.

feeds.path: SortedOracles GBP/USD rate feed -> Mento OracleAdapter.getFXRateIfValid -> GBPm FXPriceFeed -> TroveManager collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: GBPm's FXPriceFeed (0xBBB144A67f4403112b4C895Cc85d5EE4F90013DE) reads oracleAdapter.getFXRateIfValid(rateFeedID) during normal operation. Mento documents that FX market closure blocks normal price-dependent CDP actions, including normal redemptions and liquidations; cached lastValidPrice is used after emergency shutdown, not as an ordinary weekend or holiday fallback. No alternate third-party oracle provider is identified.

collateralParameters.note: On-chain SystemParamsProxyGBPm (0x70536e44d1D9238BA8E35Ffe63Bb388a63F0DE51) returned MCR=1.1e18 (110%), CCR=1.35e18 (135% critical/system ratio), and SCR=1.1e18 (110% shutdown ratio) at Celo block 72722909.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Troves below the 110% MCR are liquidated: the StabilityPoolGBPm offsets debt first (5% liquidation penalty to SP depositors, per SystemParams.LIQUIDATION_PENALTY_SP), with any shortfall redistributed to remaining troves at a 10% penalty (LIQUIDATION_PENALTY_REDISTRIBUTION). TroveManager reported 4 open trove IDs and shutdownTime=0 (not shut down) at Celo block 72722909.
branches.backstop: StabilityPoolGBPm (0x06346c0fAB682dBde9f245D2D84677592E8aaa15) holds GBPm deposits; depositors absorb liquidated debt and receive the corresponding USDm collateral at the 5% Stability Pool penalty rate before any redistribution to remaining troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: If the branch's total collateral ratio falls below the 110% SCR, redemptions are blocked (TroveManager requires TCR >= SCR and shutdownTime == 0 to permit redemption) and the branch can enter shutdown, during which FXPriceFeed serves its cached lastValidPrice instead of a live oracle read. Redistribution among remaining troves is the bad-debt backstop for any shortfall the Stability Pool cannot absorb.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GBPm is canonical on Celo and represented on Monad by Mento's Wormhole Native Token Transfer deployment. Celo is the NTT locking hub and Monad is the burning StableTokenSpoke; the NTT Manager, Wormhole Transceiver, peers, limits, pauses, and upgrades are bridge machinery scored here rather than as additional native Mint Authority.

routes.protocol: Wormhole Native Token Transfer (NTT) Celo locking hub
routes.reviewNote: At Celo block 75026011, StableTokenV3 implementation 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318 is the canonical GBPm issuer and the official MGP-14/NTT configuration marks Celo as the LOCKING hub. NTT Manager 0x7895D03FfDeb14a57eF79c21C3eA14dADf2a7c3f and Wormhole Transceiver 0xcB55fE41C5437Ad6449C2978B061958C1EC1AB5f provide canonical-side lock/release bridge machinery; that route exposure is scored at the external-validated-network tier, while native issuance remains Celo-only.

At Monad block 96633798, the GBPm deployment resolves to Mento StableTokenSpoke implementation 0x6A8ff60A89F3f359Fa16F45076d6DD1712B5e62e. The official NTT configuration marks Monad as the BURNING spoke; its NTT Manager 0x7895D03FfDeb14a57eF79c21C3eA14dADf2a7c3f is the live minter and burner, with a reciprocal Celo Manager peer, one enabled Wormhole Transceiver, and nominal 500,000e18 per-direction limits over 86,400 seconds. This is the Wormhole bridge representation of canonical Celo GBPm, not an independent native issuance route.

controls.label: GBPm Celo NTT Manager and Wormhole Transceiver Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: At Celo block 75026011, the NTT Manager 0x7895D03FfDeb14a57eF79c21C3eA14dADf2a7c3f is the LOCKING hub-side manager. It locks canonical GBPm for outbound NTT transfers and releases the conserved canonical balance on the return path; this is bridge accounting, not independent native mint authority.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Celo NTT Manager peer points to the Monad NTT Manager at the same address, and the Celo Wormhole Transceiver peer points to the Monad Transceiver at 0xcB55fE41C5437Ad6449C2978B061958C1EC1AB5f. The Celo Transceiver uses Wormhole Core 0xa321448d90d4e5b0a732867c18ea198e75cac48e.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The official GBPm NTT configuration sets nominal 500,000e18 limits in each direction with an 86,400-second duration. The Celo NTT Manager threshold is 1 with one enabled Wormhole Transceiver.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 4-of-6 Safe controls NTT Manager peer, rate-limit, transceiver, threshold, pause, and upgrade operations, and controls the Transceiver peer and implementation. At Celo block 75026011, NTT Manager and Transceiver implementation slots resolve to 0x67850dd0546e785ba81eb7fa4cf4d2f5b393cb0d and 0xdd38eac014c3dbd34ff06f966e9d24b907e992dd, respectively. A current pinned recheck at block 78940190 returned the same implementations and Safe owner/pauser.

controls.capDescription: The Celo NTT Manager and Transceiver Safe governs the canonical-side lock/release rail, peers, nominal rate limits, pause, threshold, and upgrade paths. It controls bridge exposure but does not turn the Celo route into a second native issuance deployment.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 75026011, the official GBPm NTT configuration identified Celo as the LOCKING hub with the NTT Manager 0x7895D03FfDeb14a57eF79c21C3eA14dADf2a7c3f and Wormhole Transceiver 0xcB55fE41C5437Ad6449C2978B061958C1EC1AB5f. Current reads showed the reciprocal Monad peers, threshold 1, one enabled transceiver, nominal 500,000e18 per-direction limits over 86,400 seconds, and implementation slots for both bridge contracts. The local 4-of-6 Mento Safe is the controller of this bridge machinery.

controls.label: GBPm Monad NTT Manager and Wormhole Transceiver Safe

routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: At Monad block 96633798, StableTokenSpoke reports the NTT Manager as the live minter and burner. This burn/mint route is expected representation accounting: conservation depends on the Celo locking hub, reciprocal peers, and the configured limits, not on an independent Monad native-liability path.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Monad NTT Manager peer points to the Celo NTT Manager at the same address, and the Monad Wormhole Transceiver peer points to the Celo Transceiver at 0xcB55fE41C5437Ad6449C2978B061958C1EC1AB5f. The Monad Transceiver uses Wormhole Core 0x194b123c5e96b9b2e49763619985790dc241cac0.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The official GBPm NTT configuration sets nominal 500,000e18 limits in each direction with an 86,400-second duration. The Monad NTT Manager threshold is 1 with one enabled Wormhole Transceiver.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The 4-of-6 Safe controls NTT Manager peer, rate-limit, transceiver, threshold, pause, and upgrade operations, and controls the Transceiver peer and implementation. Current pinned Monad block 109552565 returned NTT Manager implementation 0x67850dd0546e785ba81eb7fa4cf4d2f5b393cb0d and Transceiver implementation 0xdd38eac014c3dbd34ff06f966e9d24b907e992dd, with the same Safe as owner/pauser. The prior block 96633798 implementation slot could not be re-read on this RPC; the current addresses are not backdated.

controls.capDescription: The Monad NTT Manager and Transceiver Safe governs the bridge representation's burn/mint rail, peers, nominal rate limits, pause, threshold, and upgrade paths. The NTT Manager's token roles are bridge capabilities, not Celo native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At Monad block 96633798, GBPm resolved to StableTokenSpoke implementation 0x6A8ff60A89F3f359Fa16F45076d6DD1712B5e62e and the NTT Manager was the live minter and burner. The NTT Manager and Transceiver shared the Celo deployment addresses, reciprocal peers, threshold 1, one enabled transceiver, nominal 500,000e18 per-direction limits over 86,400 seconds, and Safe ownership. The bridge representation is material but route-scoped and externally validated by Wormhole messaging; relayer-specific status getters were unavailable in the deployed Transceiver ABI and were not inferred.

controls.label: GBPm Monad StableTokenSpoke ProxyAdmin

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Monad block 96633798, the StableTokenSpoke proxy resolved to implementation 0x6A8ff60A89F3f359Fa16F45076d6DD1712B5e62e and ProxyAdmin 0x7f017a0a94e4fe5afe688064afd76b25d4dac8ea. The ProxyAdmin owner is the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe, so this can replace bridge-representation logic; it is not the Celo native mint-authority admin.

controls.evidence: At Monad block 96633798, ProxyAdmin 0x7f017a0a94e4fe5afe688064afd76b25d4dac8ea fronted the StableTokenSpoke representation and was owned by the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe that controls the NTT Manager and Transceiver. Its upgrade power is bridge-side representation risk and has been relocated from Mint Authority.
